senses.sense_definition: A contractual financial arrangement where money or assets are held by a third party until specific conditions are fulfilled.

examples.text: The buyers placed their deposit into an <w>escrow</w> account before the property inspection was complete.
Until all legal conditions are fully met, the money remains safely held in <w>escrow</w>.

senses.sense_definition: The actual funds, money, or property that are kept in trust under an escrow agreement.

examples.text: The court will determine which party is entitled to receive the <w>escrow</w>.
Once the contract terms were verified, the firm released the <w>escrow</w> to the seller.

senses.sense_definition: To deposit or place funds, documents, or property in the custody of a third party until conditions are met.

examples.text: The law requires lenders to <w>escrow</w> monthly tax and insurance payments for certain loans.
The buyer agreed to <w>escrow</w> funds to ensure the repairs would be completed promptly.
